title: Find and fix several independent bugs across 40 TypeScript modules
prompt:
This project has 40 small integer-array transformation stages in src/stages/stageNN.ts; the doc comment at the top of each module is its specification. The test suite fails: some stages contain bugs. Fix every buggy stage so that it matches its specification. Do not modify anything under test/ and do not change modules that are already correct.

When you are done, write FIXED.json at the repository root: a JSON array of the paths (relative to the repository root, for example "src/stages/stage03.ts") of every source file you changed, sorted alphabetically.

Run the tests with: node --test test/*.test.ts (the output is long: one line per test case).
